name: nginx-multisite
description: Provides Nginx hosting for three virtual hosts, including static content, SSL certificates, service management, firewall rules, Fail2ban, sysctl hardening, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including authentication, runtime directories, logging, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with its dependencies and environment configuration, and manages a systemd Uvicorn service on port 8000.
